description.value: Viet Flavour Restaurant is a Vietnamese eatery on West Broadway serving pho, vermicelli bowls, bánh mì, and fresh salad rolls. With 81 customer reviews and a dedicated vegetarian section on the menu, it caters to a range of dietary needs. Online ordering with quick pickup makes it a practical stop for cyclists passing through the Kitsilano–South Granville corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at vietflavourrestaurant.com corroborates the OSM address (1822 W Broadway, Vancouver, BC V6J1Y9) and phone (+1 604-737-8075). The site prominently features 'Order Now Pickup 15 min' confirming takeout, and the menu includes an explicit 'Vegetarian Options' section with items like Veggie Vietnamese Sub and Tofu Salad Rolls. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities.
